ขอ
ขอ

Now build some things you've never heard whole. Ask her if she wants to drink water.

One small thing in there — gɔ̂ɔ dâi after here. It means here is fine, here works. Say it: here is fine.

Now you. Are you hungry?
หิวมั้ยคะ

อยากกินที่นี่ค่ะ
